pairs.evidence: crates/core/tests/blocking_gate_guard.rs:127 The guard decides whether a CI job blocks from the literal text of a job-level `continue-on-error:` at indent 4. It ignores step-level `continue-on-error: true` (indent 8) and treats an expression value such as `${{ ... }}` as blocking. A hard-pass job neutralised either way would still pass this guard: the error is in the permissive direction, latent today.
